description: A deployed Bun service, such as a Cloudflare Worker. The bundle carries the dependency tree, so a runtime bump changes what runs and cuts a release.

Lock file maintenance is a chore, as in every preset, so a refreshed transitive dependency ships with the next release a user-facing change cuts. An advisory against one does not wait for it: the daily audit reports it, and its fix is a fix commit.
config:recommended makes a runtime dependency a fix commit and everything else a chore.
